chapters.title: The Lord is slow to anger
chapters.summary: The Lord is slow to anger and great in power, a stronghold in the day of trouble. Good news for Judah: Assyria's oppression will end.

chapters.title: Nineveh's fall
chapters.summary: A vivid picture of the attack on Nineveh: chariots in the streets, the river gates opened, and the lion's den destroyed.

chapters.title: Woe to the bloody city
chapters.summary: Nineveh, the city full of lies and violence, will fall like ripe figs. All who hear of it will clap their hands.
